notes: Modified cash basis school district; amounts from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp3-5) of the governmental funds statement. Cash = checking/savings plus cash at county treasurers; beginning cash is the beginning fund balance (4,696,690, p4) and ending 3,865,204. Interfund transfers (38,500 out of General, 38,500 into Other Governmental funds, p4) are blank in the total column; recorded as transfers_out 38,500 and transfers_in 38,500 from the fund columns (net zero). The statement's General Fund column also combines the Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (General 2,253,002 + Depreciation 246,961 + Employee Benefit 20,921 = 2,520,884); the 240,000 transfer from General to Depreciation is eliminated inside that column, but the General Fund schedule's disbursement total 4,834,415 still contains it (statement GF disbursements 4,594,665 = 4,834,415 - 38,500 - 240,000 + Depreciation 20,000 + Employee Benefit 18,750). Recorded as a contra line (-240,000, instruction group) plus an other financing line, with review. Transfers match: Nutrition 30,000 + Activities 8,500 = 38,500. General Fund detail function mapping (3400/3535/3551/federal 6xxx to instruction; Depreciation capital outlay shown in student transportation on the statement) was derived by reconciling to the statement's function lines; General Fund function sums tie to the statement except the hidden 240,000. Exhibit of cash disbursements by object (program x object) is not in the trimmed PDF, so General Fund spending is not itemized by object. Debt service and Special Building 'Building debt services' have principal and interest combined (recorded as principal, review). Special Building budget line 'Purchased services' with no actual skipped. Balance sheet is the cash-basis assets/net position section of the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2); no liabilities shown. Component unit (School Foundation) excluded.
